raw_segments.text: She stretched out her hand and I went down on my knee and put it to my lips
I had not considered how I should take leave of her it came naturally to me at the moment to do this
She looked at Sarah pocket with triumph in her weird eyes
And so I left my fairy godmother with both her hands on her crutch stick
Standing in the midst of the dimly lighted room beside the rotten bride cake that was hidden in cobwebs
